name: Morrow Quiet Mania 2026
information: This competition takes place on **SATURDAY** and only features Clock, FMC, and Blindfolded events. Therefore, it may not be suitable for newer competitors. Please click [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MorrowMixupMania2026) to view the page for the Morrow Mixup Mania 2026 competition which does feature 3x3, or see [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list) for a list of other upcoming competitions in Ohio. You can find out about upcoming competitions in our area in our local Facebook group: [Ohio and Michigan Speedcubing](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1655301714974534/) Morrow Quiet Mania 2026 is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](www.midwestcubing.org) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6OTQ4MDEsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--1799465e8f962e1cc618cf35c06c44a48142c2fe/image.png) contact@midwestcubing.org
